summary:
Phase 12c (Session Impact Rating) + Phase 12d (Monthly Harmonic Blueprint Report) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: all 9 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_impact_and_report.py pass (7.41s total via xdist). Endpoints confirmed: (a) GET /api/hb/pending-impact-ratings returns 401 unauth, only surfaces HB-recommended entries ≥24h old with no impact_rating; label falls back preset_label → soundscape → 'X Hz'. (b) POST /api/hb/impact-rating persists, is idempotent (overrides on resubmit), 422 for invalid rating value, 404 for foreign/nonexistent entry_id. (c) GET /api/hb/effective-frequencies — 402 for free, aggregates by rounded frequency, excludes sample_count<2, weights clear_shift=3/subtle_difference=1/not_sure=0, normalised to 0-100, sorted by score desc then sample_count desc, top 5. Verified 432 Hz → 78% (mean 2.33/3) 3 samples and 528 Hz → 33% (mean 1/3) 2 samples; 396 Hz single-sample correctly excluded. (d) GET /api/hb/monthly-report — 402 free, returns {report: null, available_months: []} when <2 non-eigenmode captures this month; else lazily composes + persists into hb_monthly_reports with full shape (month, title 'Your MonthName Resonance Journey', total_sessions, resonance_score_current/previous/delta, most_improved_ranges [closure_db>0.5], most_persistent_gaps [current_severity>=3], recommended_frequencies as center Hz, listening_seconds/minutes). Curl against seeded user returned title 'Your July Resonance Journey', current=82, previous=60, delta=22, listening_minutes=70. (e) /api/hb/monthly-report/{month} → 400 for bad format, 404 for empty month, 200 with report shape otherwise.

Frontend: Verified with seeded Pro user (ui_impact_test@example.com / Impact9!, 5 resonance_profiles + 6 wellness_journey rows including 1 unrated ≥26h-old HB-recommended prompt seed). (1) SessionImpactPrompt renders post-login (data-testid=session-impact-prompt), gold-accent label '396 Hz Grounding' (data-testid=session-impact-prompt-label), all three option buttons present (clear_shift/subtle_difference/not_sure), dismiss X closes without saving. (2) EffectiveFrequenciesCard renders in HB Account section (data-testid=effective-frequencies-card) with 2 rows: row-432 shows '432 Hz Earth · 432 Hz · 3 rated sessions · 78% EFFECTIVENESS', row-528 shows '528 Hz Cellular · 528 Hz · 2 rated sessions · 33% EFFECTIVENESS'. (3) MonthlyReportEntry (data-testid=monthly-report-entry) displays 'Your July Resonance Journey · 3 sessions · score 82 · +22 vs last month'. Clicking opens MonthlyReportCard (data-testid=monthly-report-card) full-screen modal with title 'Your July Resonance Journey', stat tiles 3 sessions / score 82 / 1h 10m listening, MOST IMPROVED (Lower grounding, Mid-harmonic), PERSISTENT GAPS (Mid-harmonic 4.0 dB), RECOMMENDED FOCUS 1250 Hz, warm closing 'Every capture teaches your blueprint. Rest tonight — tomorrow the tuning continues.' + Continue your journey CTA. Both monthly-report-close (X) and monthly-report-continue dismiss the modal. (4) Regression — Before/After Frequency Map (before-after-map + before-after-map-summary) and Drift Over Time still render alongside the new cards. Design in Solarisound dark palette with warm-gold accents matches spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (~6100+ lines with Phase 12c/12d added). Feature routers should be split into modules (carried recommendation from iter 59/60).

Monthly report is lazily generated and persisted to db.hb_monthly_reports — good for idempotency, but there is no invalidation when a new capture is added within the same month after the report is generated. Consider invalidating/regenerating when total_sessions changes, or the report can become stale until the next month.
impact_rating currently only allows override; there is no audit trail of prior ratings if a user changes their mind. Not required by spec but noting for future analytics accuracy.
hb_monthly_reports doc is returned with mongo _id excluded (verified via curl — no _id present in response). ✓
